# QCrypton PQC Engine — Post-Quantum Cryptography Operations Dashboard

Runtime cryptographic telemetry from PQC Engine instances on F5 BIG-IP. Tracks PQC adoption, policy enforcement, vulnerable algorithm detections, and KEM/signature operations. Data source: `PQCEngine_CL`.

content.query:
PQCEngine_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == 'handshake'
| summarize Count = count() by ClientClass
| render piechart
content.title: Client classification distribution

content.query:
PQCEngine_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType in ('handshake', 'kex_complete')
| summarize Count = count() by NegotiatedGroup
| order by Count desc
| render piechart
content.title: Negotiated key exchange groups

content.query:
PQCEngine_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == 'handshake'
| summarize PQCHybrid = countif(ClientClass == 'pqc_hybrid'), PQCNative = countif(ClientClass == 'pqc_native'), Classical = countif(ClientClass == 'classical'), Legacy = countif(ClientClass == 'legacy') by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: PQC vs classical handshakes over time

content.query:
PQCEngine_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType in ('policy_block', 'policy_upgrade')
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), EventType
| render timechart
content.title: Policy enforcement events over time

content.query:
PQCEngine_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == 'handshake'
| summarize Total = count(), PQC = countif(PQCNegotiated == 1), Classical = countif(PQCNegotiated == 0), PolicyBlocks = countif(EventType == 'policy_block') by Hostname, InstanceId
| extend PQCPct = round(100.0 * PQC / Total, 1)
| project Hostname, InstanceId, Total, PQC, Classical, PQCPct
| order by Total desc
content.title: Per-instance summary

content.query:
PQCEngine_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == 'vuln_detected'
| summarize Count = count() by Algorithm, Detail
| order by Count desc
content.title: Vulnerable algorithms detected

content.query:
PQCEngine_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Success == 0
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), EventType
| render timechart
content.title: Failed operations over time
